title: Modeling and Simulation Credibility Assessment of Explicit FEA for Total Knee Replacement Wear and Contact Mechanics
runhead: Credibility of Explicit FEA for TKR Wear
device: Posterior-stabilized total knee replacement with cobalt-chromium femoral component, UHMWPE tibial insert, and modular tibial tray

models.name: Model 1 — Component-Level Explicit FE
models.what_it_computes: Femoral component–polyethylene contact pressures, contact areas, sliding distances, cross-shear metrics, and Archard-type wear depth/volume under prescribed kinematics consistent with simulator-style inputs; no surrounding soft tissues.

models.name: Model 2 — Anatomy-Coupled Explicit FE
models.what_it_computes: Joint contact mechanics, backside interface micromotion, ligament constraint reaction forces (via nonlinear springs), cross-shear–dependent wear on the tibial insert under load-driven boundary conditions with malalignment and high-flexion maneuvers.

mechanisms.name: Steady-State Tibial Insert Wear During Level Walking
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Long-term polyethylene volume loss and wear scar evolution drive survivorship and revision risk.

mechanisms.name: Varus–Valgus Edge Loading
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Rim contact elevates peak pressures and local stresses, accelerating wear and risking insert damage.

mechanisms.name: Backside Interface Micromotion and Fretting
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Relative motion at the insert–tray junction contributes to particulate generation and locking feature degradation.

mechanisms.name: High-Flexion Pivoting Cross-Shear
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Combined axial load and transverse pivoting elevates cross-shear, increasing wear rate beyond gait-only conditions.

deviation.detail: Credibility scores are reported on a continuous 0–12 Explicit FEA Credibility Index with interpretive thresholds at 3, 6, and 9 for screening, developing, and established levels.
